changes.text: Block 2 no longer shows a single expected completion year: SF YIMBY (February 2026) says overall completion by 2030, the SF Chronicle (July 2026) says a phased opening from 2028, and Bisnow (May 2025) said construction would be completed by 2029. The February 2026 entry now reads as a report that foundation work was underway, and notes that the article dates the start of construction to August 2025.

Block 2 (UCSF): overall completion is now shown as expected by 2030 per the project team (SF YIMBY, Feb 2026), replacing a 'late 2028' date the article does not give. The address is stated as 420 23rd Street, with 249 Craig Ln as the Assessor's address, and the distance to the unrelated parcel it was once matched to is about 125 m, not 250 m. Five DBI permit dates that had recorded the issue date as the filing or completion date were corrected. The financing structure is described as the plan Bisnow reported in May 2025 ($575 million, 'more than half a billion dollars'), the Regents' CEQA document is described as findings put before the Regents, since it does not record adoption, and several citations now point to the article or dataset that states the claim.

changes.text: Nine minor building permits move from the timeline to a separate list of building permits: six tieback permits for the shoring system supporting the Block 2 UCSF development, two permits for a temporary exterior facade mock-up, and one administrative City Planning impact-fee permit. None set the record's status, so the status shown does not change. Their cost entries move with them as each permit's own valuation.
A temporary exterior facade mock-up was permitted for Power Station Block 2, to stand two to three years.
Block 2's temporary facade mock-up structure was estimated and revised to cost $745,000.
Block 2 is described in its permit filing as a clinical life science building.
A tieback permit supporting Block 2's main shoring system was approved for documentation purposes.
That tieback support permit's cost was estimated and revised to $210,000.
Block 2's development was approved under CPC Motion No. 21581.

An administrative permit for a City Planning TSF impact fee on new construction of an 8-story, non-residential mixed-use building was issued for block 4175, lot 027, pursuant to CPC Motion No. 21581. The permit description itself does not name Block 2.
A second tieback permit for Block 2's shoring system was approved for documentation purposes.
That tieback permit's cost was revised to $297,000.
A third tieback-only permit for Block 2's shoring system was issued.
That permit's cost was revised to $206,000.
A tieback permit for Lot C's shoring, supporting Block 2, was issued.
The Lot C tieback permit's cost was estimated and revised to $210,000.
Another tieback-only permit for Block 2's shoring system was issued.
That permit's cost was estimated and revised to $206,000.
A permit was filed for Block 2's exterior facade visual mock-up.
Block 2 is again described in permit filings as a clinical life science building.
A sixth tieback-only permit for Block 2's shoring system was issued.
That permit's cost was estimated and revised to $329,000.

open_questions: The UC Regents' Finance and Capital Strategies Committee had the project before it as Action Item F5 for its September 18, 2024 meeting (asked to adopt the CEQA findings, approve Amendment No. 12 to the 2014 Long Range Development Plan and approve the design); no minutes or action record was read, so the outcome of that item is not confirmed.

Reported square footage varies across four dated sources (Aug 2025 SF YIMBY, Feb 2026 SF YIMBY, the Feb 2026 Planning Director memo, and Bisnow) by up to about 22,000 sq ft (about 278,000 sq ft is Pier & Point's own sum of the Planning Director memo's three figures, 685 + 89,476 + 187,819 = 277,980 sq ft; SF YIMBY's August 2025 figures sum to 278,915; 285,500 in February 2026; about 300,000 in Bisnow), and the figures do not all measure the same thing; no single figure is treated as final here.

Overall completion date is reported inconsistently: Chronicle (Jul 2026) says opening in phases from 2028; Bisnow (May 2025) said completion by 2029; SF YIMBY (Feb 2026) says overall completion expected 2030. Not reconciled.
The Real Deal's May 9, 2025 article on the $575M bond issuance is paywalled and could not be checked; Bisnow's coverage of the same financing was used instead.

No source found giving a signed lease date between UCSF and the developer. The UC Regents' September 18, 2024 item F5 says "All lease terms are expected to be 30 years in duration", an expected term for the proposed structure, not a signed lease.

As of 2026-09-29, the Regents' September 2024 CEQA-findings attachment says the project 'is now being considered for final approval'; no Regents minutes or action record recording adoption (or its date) was found, so the timeline says the findings were put before the Regents.

Who the general contractor is: SF YIMBY (February 9, 2026) says "Webcor Builders is the general contractor", while IBank's April 2025 staff report says "The Construction Company/Developer is DPR Associate Capital". No building-permit contractor of record was checked.

As of 2026-10-12, no closing or pricing document for the IBank bonds was found. IBank's staff report for its April 23, 2025 board meeting (Resolution No. 25-09) is a request for authorization with an "Expected Closing Date" of May 28, 2025; the ground-lease/sublease arrangement is recorded as the plan described there and in Bisnow's May 2025 report.

The $575 million figure is a ceiling: IBank's staff report (board meeting April 23, 2025, Resolution No. 25-09) recommends bonds "in an aggregate amount not to exceed $575,000,000" and gives an expected closing date of May 28, 2025, and says the bonds "will be secured by an Indenture and sold through a public offering to Goldman Sachs & Co., LLC, as representative of the underwriters". Bisnow (2025-05-13) reports a plan to sell bonds, not a completed sale. No closing document or issued amount was found, so no financing is recorded as closed.

Floor area of the building, by source: the Design Review approval (Feb 2026) gives approx. 685 sf retail, 89,476 sf laboratory and 187,819 sf Institutional Healthcare (Non-Hospital); SF YIMBY (Aug 2025, citing Sept 2024 plans) gives 188,550 sf institutional healthcare, 89,680 sf laboratory and 685 sf retail; SF YIMBY (Feb 2026) gives 285,500 sf occupiable floor area in total (182,650 institutional healthcare, 102,200 lab, ~700 retail); Bisnow (May 2025) gives ~300,000 sf overall.

Ground lease structure: as announced in May 2025 (Bisnow), the California IBank would sell more than half a billion dollars in tax-exempt bonds to Goldman Sachs and lend the proceeds to the nonprofit Campus Facilities Improvement Association, which would ground-lease from the Regents of the University of California and sublease to Associate Capital, which would build out the site. This is the planned structure; no closing or pricing document has been found.

record.notes: Block 2, 420 23rd Street (Assessor address 249 Craig Ln) -- Herzog & de Meuron-designed UCSF life sciences/cancer research building; foundation excavation underway Feb 2026, overall completion expected by 2030, per the project team (sfyimby.com/2026/02/excavation-work-underway-for-potrero-power-station-block-2-san-francisco.html). CORRECTED 2026-09-16: this row previously pointed to blklot 4232022 (151 Humboldt St), added on a text-match to this same article's mention of 'Block 2' without checking geometry. The D4D's Figure 6.2.3 places Block 2 west of Block 3, fronting Craig Lane -- blklot 4232022's real Assessor geometry instead sits about 125 m away (about 74 m south and 101 m east of 4175027, centroid to centroid), roughly where the diagram's Block 8 is, with no visible construction activity there in satellite imagery. blklot 4175027 (active parcel, address 249 Craig Ln, recorded 2022-08-30) sits exactly where the diagram places Block 2, and its boundary precisely outlines a real excavation pit with visible crane/equipment in current satellite imagery -- a strong match to this article's 'excavation underway' description. The '151 Humboldt St' address from the original (wrong) row could not be independently reconfirmed against this corrected parcel and may itself have been an error; flagging rather than asserting it. blklot 4232022's own true identity is still unconfirmed and is NOT claimed to be any other specific numbered block here.
